dedupe_keys.name: prediction of seismic collapse behavior of deep steel wide flange columns using machine learning methods

description: Prediction of Seismic Collapse Behavior of Deep Steel Wide-Flange Columns Using Machine Learning Methods is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Sherif El-Tawil, University of Michigan (umich.edu). In this project, we explore the efficiency of different machine learning (ML) methods in predicting the seismic collapse behavior of steel deep wide flange (W-shape) columns. Steel Column Net (SCNet), a database of more than nine hundred deep W-shape columns subjected to combined axial and lateral loads is collected and compiled. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Seismic Behavior, Deep W-shape Columns, Machine Learning, Failure Mode, Collapse Behavior. Published 2020-09-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
